title: Cold rebuild: fail fast at the call
summary: The eager-validation pattern again, from an empty editor.

steps.title: From memory
body: Rebuild `LoadAsync` from *Fail fast at the call*: an empty editor, no hints, the same tests.
The pattern is small, but getting it right without looking proves you understand where an async method's exceptions go.

steps.prompt: Warm-up: in `static async Task Run(string? s) { ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(s); await Work(s); }`, when does the caller see the exception for `Run(null)`?
options: Only when it awaits (or waits on) the returned task
steps.explain: The state machine stores it in the task, which becomes Faulted. Only a non-async outer method can throw at the call.

steps.title: Rebuild LoadAsync cold
prompt: Write `static Task<string> LoadAsync(string? key, Store store)`: throw `ArgumentException` **at the call** for a null or empty key;
otherwise return `"value of "` + the result of `await store.GetAsync(key)`.
